title: CmdPal: Failed page unsubscribe skips child cleanup (EXT26.C4)

judgment.rationale: The issue reports a reproduced content/details cleanup failure and source checks for list cleanup and cached task behavior. Related issue 50500 is closed, but its public description does not establish that this exception-specific defect is fixed.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the targeted maintainer reproduction to validate the proposed mechanism before design approval; no upstream action has been taken.
evidence: Content/details cleanup failure was reproduced after PropChanged removal threw.
List ordering, SafeCleanup's outer catch and cached task behavior were checked in source.
Related issue 50500 is closed but concerns navigation retention, not explicitly this throwing-unsubscribe case.

fix_assessment.rationale: No matching fix was identified by focused issue-number search; keep the mechanism as a hypothesis pending reproduction.

plan: Separate best-effort parent unsubscribe from child cleanup so one failure does not skip owned resources.
Attempt each child cleanup independently and record failures without abandoning the rest.
Keep the shared terminal task and active-operation wait, but make completion cover all child cleanup attempts.
Test content/details and list/filter pages with throwing unsubscribe and repeated cleanup.
verification: Make PropChanged removal throw on content and list pages; verify every owned child is still cleaned once.
Await CleanupAsync twice and check repeated cleanup remains safe.
Hold an active operation during cleanup and verify task completion waits for it and child cleanup.
proposed_fixes.title: Correct the reported Command Palette lifecycle failure
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Parent event removal can throw before derived pages clean children; the broad catch skips remaining work and cached CleanupAsync completion prevents retry.

confidence.rationale: Content/details failure is reproduced and source supports list behavior; child ordering and terminal-task semantics need focused coverage.
